semantics.order_rule: Assurance levels are ordered none < light < medium < strong.
semantics.profile_rule: Required factors/methods for each level are explicit by IAM profile.
semantics.evidence_rule: Assurance evidence references exact successful authentication attempts/factors.
semantics.session_rule: Session may hold the highest currently valid assurance supported by unexpired evidence.
semantics.authorization_rule: Higher assurance never automatically grants broader AccessCore permissions.
semantics.downgrade_rule: Expired/revoked factor evidence may reduce effective assurance.
semantics.remote_rule: Remote mapping of assurance requirements is customer/policy-defined.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.
